name: IC 4870 (Hubble)
blurb: IC 4870, a Seyfert galaxy with an active nucleus, seen by Hubble.
label: ic4870-hubble
story: IC 4870 hides an active galactic nucleus, a core so bright it can outshine the rest of the galaxy put together. It is a Seyfert galaxy, a kind of active galaxy known by its telltale emission lines.

claims.text: IC 4870 contains an active galactic nucleus
IC 4870 is a Seyfert galaxy, a kind of AGN with characteristic emission lines
